output_parameterization: x0: second returned value of WanDiffusionWrapper; raw network predicts flow; x0=xt-sigma*flow; do not relabel as epsilon
timestep_policy: derive from original scheduler/config; compare to recorded native list; no integer truncation
layer_indexing: zero-based original model.blocks enumerate, unchanged from v07
query_policy: all4680 raw queries per current chunk, no mean pooling, no subsampling in network output loss
visibility: all passed history and whole current chunk; no triangular token-causal mask

cfg.reason: original CausalInferencePipeline uses one conditional forward, no unconditional/CFG mixing

router.assignment: 36 independent128->8 K-only, same assignments aggregate K and V, never migrate Joint-KV S8 as K-only
router.normalization: train-only initial fixed cells; freeze per-pair feature means/std and initial Huber scale

history_gradient: all history reencoded with current student parameters; older no_grad; recent3 latent frames fixed and KV writes differentiable; no trajectory backprop
context_encoding: dense context/cache-write rerun as original; only denoising current forward sparsifies specified layers
test_policy: new prompt-held-out Test only; old exposed Test excluded; architecture/checkpoint registry must lock before evaluator can read Test

warmstart.selection: normalized initial-scale cal_Huber + hard Attention NMSE on fixed balanced legacy Val cells; then head warm-start on full replay with x0 output NMSE; initialize branches with identical calibrated K-only weights
warmstart.sketch_objective: cal_Huber/train_initial_scale +0.1*hard_attention_nmse; V only in supervision, never K routing forward

precision: Backbone and executing hard attention use native BF16 SDPA at full current-query length; Router/calibration rawQK/lossFP32; stable continuous gate VJP/reductionsFP64; TF32 disabled. No double QKV gradient.

audit_tolerances.policy: fixed before real run; failure stops; no post-hoc relaxation

validation: all8 prompts x2 generation seeds x3 histories x4 steps; each input whole current chunk; prompt-equal main endpoint; best and fixedlast and init all retained

endpoint.bootstrap_unit: prompt; same resample allmodels and training seeds

scope: network-output offline algorithm verification only; not original DMD training or video quality verification
